neighbours.label: ' eye(s)' as the target of a gaze: looking someone in the eye / into their eyes
fire: When the coach confronted him, the boy looked him in the eye and said nothing.
Before signing the deal, Maria looked the banker in the eye for a long moment.
I could not look my mother in the eye after breaking her favourite vase.
The old soldier looked the young recruit in the eye and told him the truth.
On their wedding day he looked into her eyes and forgot his vows.
If you want a job, look the interviewer in the eye and shake hands firmly.
The judge looked the defendant in the eye before reading the sentence.
She knelt down, looked the frightened child in the eye, and smiled.
quiet: When the coach examined him, the boy had a small cut above his eye.
Before signing the deal, Maria had laser surgery on her right eye.
I could not see well out of my left eye after the accident.
The old soldier wore a patch over the eye he lost in the war.
On their wedding day he got a speck of dust in his eye.
If you want clear vision, have an eye exam once every two years.
The judge rubbed his tired eyes before reading the sentence.
She knelt down and put drops into the frightened child's eye.

notes: Card top 32 are ' eye'/' eyes'/' face'/' mirror' after look/looked ... in the / into. Probe: anatomical 'eye' (surgery, itchy eye) stays near zero; 'in the face' fires about half as much.
